newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish biotech Biora to seek Sweden, U.S. listing.
newsitem.headline: Swedish biotech Biora to seek Sweden, U.S. listing.

text.p: Swedish biotechnology company Biora AB on Friday said it was to seek a listing in Stockholm and on NASDAQ in New York.
"The application is taking place in connection with an issue of shares totalling around $50 million, which will be registered under the U.S. Securities Act from 1933," Biora AB said in a statement.

It said Biora, based in southern Swedish city Malmo, had developed and owns several patents for production of biological-based products for treatment of disease that cause gum decay and teeth to fall out.

"Income from the new issue will be used to establish a sales organisation in the U.S., to strengthen the European marketing organisation, to develop new applications and treatment methods as well as increase research and development resources," it said.
